# SOP-P3-L3-03 First-article inspection - Machining line

Revision: Rev B  
Plant: P3, line P3-L3  
Equipment: EQ-P3-L3-SB01, EQ-P3-L3-CN02, EQ-P3-L3-HP03  
Related documents: ECN-2026-016, MM-P3-L3-HP03, MM-P3-L3-SB01

Purpose
1. Verify first-article parts produced on line P3-L3 meet drawing and process requirements prior to production release.

Preconditions
1. Machine setup complete and verified against program for the part.
2. Tooling and fixtures installed per MM-P3-L3-HP03 and MM-P3-L3-SB01.
3. Calibration certificates for inspection gages are current and available.
4. The lubricant part number for Machining shot blast cabinet #1 (EQ-P3-L3-SB01) is CFW-LUB-709.
5. The blast wheel liner bolt torque for Machining shot blast cabinet #1 (EQ-P3-L3-SB01) is 105 N·m.

PPE
1. Safety glasses.
2. Cut-resistant gloves.
3. Steel-toe footwear.
4. Hearing protection for operators in blast/cabinet areas.

Procedure
1. Material verification: Confirm material lot matches work order and ECN-2026-016 requirements. Record lot ID.
2. Machine verification: Confirm program number and offsets loaded on EQ-P3-L3-HP03 per MM-P3-L3-HP03. Verify coolant and clamp functions on EQ-P3-L3-CN02.
3. First-article run: Produce 1 representative part. Capture cycle report and machine log.
4. Dimensional inspection: Perform full inspection per drawing with calibrated gages. Record actuals on the first-article inspection record.
5. Surface and finish: Inspect visual and blast finish using EQ-P3-L3-SB01; record any deviations and reference MM-P3-L3-SB01 for corrective actions.
6. Nonconformance: If any characteristic is out of tolerance, stop the line, log NCR, and notify engineering per ECN-2026-016.

Sign-off
1. Inspector name, signature, date.
2. Process engineer name, signature, date.
3. Production supervisor name, signature, date.

Retention
1. Attach completed first-article inspection record to the lot paperwork and retain per plant document control.
